An installation runs Spinbox `v20261125.01`, the release of spin this site is generated from, which spin-terraform-aws's image catalog has images of. It is made of:

| Part | Release | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| spin: the control plane, the runner, the proxy and the CLI | `v20261125.01` | the site's `versions.yaml`, its pin of spin |
| spin-machine: QEMU, the guest kernel, the firmware and the base image a workspace boots, as one artefact | [`v20261124.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/machine/releases/tag/v20261124.01) | spin's `versions.yaml` at `v20261125.01` |
| The OpenTofu module, spin-terraform-aws | [`v20261123.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-terraform-aws/releases/tag/v20261123.01) | its newest release tag |

The versions of QEMU and the guest kernel in spin-machine `v20261124.01` are its own [`versions.yaml`](https://github.com/spin-stack/machine/blob/v20261124.01/versions.yaml) at that tag. The host's kernel is the Spin OS image's: none of the sources this site is generated from records its version.

## Spin OS images

Each machine boots the image of its role, in a region that has all three ([Spin OS images](/reference/terraform/images/)):

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-036d78b81bae19930` | `ami-038b9f719b33ef6c1` | `ami-089c2ae3a6b4da4d7` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-003b36af00d4d140b` | `ami-0f00dee4e3a6203b4` | `ami-0f54c73e8a48921fa` |
